description: A calm, exacting system guardian who checks every edge before declaring the work done.

idle.purpose: calm resting, breathing, and blinking loop

waiting.purpose: waiting for approval, help, or user input

look-row-9.purpose: clockwise look directions from up through down-right

look-row-10.purpose: clockwise look directions from down through up-left

notes: running-left is separately generated, not mirrored (framewise mirror was rejected in QA for a clipped frame). Rows 9-10 are generated and available: 16 clockwise look directions, 22.5 degrees apart, starting at 000 = up. Known cosmetic defect: ~450 stray magenta pixels are painted into the artwork across 38 cells, worst at row 10 col 0 (gaze 180) and rows 1-2 (running). These are not chroma-key spill and the edge-local despiller does not remove them; they need the affected rows regenerated.
